scopeNotes: New text needs independent review; earlier hashes do not certify it.
Map endpoints are not historical founding or extinction dates.

Four imported intervals:PortugueseEastAfrica1650–1878,PortugueseEastAfrica1900–1914,Mozambique1920–1938,andMozambique1960–present. The shared card is regional, with colonial sovereignty ending1975. It does not treat the first Portuguese port as the founding of all local societies, nor the historical territorial outline as the current country. No polygons, generated base data or Asia-assigned research are altered.

SADC’shistoricalcountryparagraph and theOfficeoftheHistorianrecognition account were read in indexed text. Only1975independence and1994multipartyhistory are used fromSADC; currentofficeholders, business language generalisations, prices and political evaluations are excluded. TheJune25date is also the scheduled date in the1974UNdecolonizationpublication, whose opening main text was read indexed; directPDFaccess returned an error. The transitional government swornSeptember20,1974 is not confused withSeptember25commemorations.

Machel’s1985GeneralAssemblyaddress was read in indexed opening paragraphs as an identifiedparticipant’sretrospective account ofSeptember25,1964. It is not a neutral description of every faction. TheUNONUMOZmission account’s peaceagreement and electoral context was read indexed. Different sources give14versus16years of civil war and varying start conventions; this card does not force them into one unsupported exactstartyear.1992agreement and1994elections are separate, and no permanentpost1994peace is claimed.

UNESCO’sIslandofMozambiquesynthesis was read in indexed main text. Trading connections predate Portuguese arrival. StoneTown andMacutiTown are particular parts of the island, not representative of all Mozambican homes. The1898capitaltransfer is corroborated by the municipal museum history. The fortress restoration book contains an inconsistent1822capitaldate in one foreword and a misleading claim that urban settlement began only after1498; these are not adopted.

MahumaneandSimbine2023 was accessed as a21-pagewebPDF. Selected main sections were read:historicalwreckcontext anddisturbance pp4–7,olivejars andLumbopottery pp13–16. A localdownload or complete reading of all21pages is not claimed. The authors explicitly discuss possible mixing with an adjacent wreck and imperfect terrestrial chronologies. The twoLumbopots are therefore not securelydated1608in the card. Olivejars are named as a type, with generalpossiblecontents, not residueanalysis. Commercial recovery and loss of archaeologicalcontext are not described as exemplary excavation. This paper and itsResearchGatecopy share one200-wordbudget.

UNESCO2009fortresspublication was accessed as a32-pagewebPDF; selected history, restoration and community passages were read, notably printedpages12,20–26. Thepublicbudget is shared across all threefortstories. Watercollection and1607siege are historical claims, not directmodernwaterqualitytests. Construction included enslavedworkers; neither colonialachievement nor localagency is erased. MohammadCassimo’schildhood/professional aspirations come from hisfirstpersoninterview; nofuturecareeroutcome orcurrentage is inferred.

The2014conservationreport is a20-pagewebPDFdatedMaputo27March2014. Relevant sections onprintedpages14–17were read for roofing,sanitationandwaterwork.2012publictoilet is supported by itsphoto caption and text; nointernalfixture is invented. The2015report is a14-pagewebPDF with acoverreferring to2014committee decisions but documentdated2015. Printedpages4–5support2015memorial andhospitalwork. Proposals and targets are distinguished fromcompletedwork; dubiouspopulation androadpercentagefigures are excluded. Relatedreports have distinctclaims and conservativecombinedbudgetbelow200where practical.

ChopiTimbila andIngomaYaMapiko inscription descriptions were read in full indexed text. They concern different namedcommunities and differentperformancetraditions.2008/2005and2023are heritageinscription/proclamationdates, not dates of invention. Children besidegrandparents, m’zenosocialcommentary andMakondechoralchallenges are described without inventing lyrics or imposing identicalcustoms on allMozambicans. No therapeuticclaim is attached to ritualperformance.

BritishMuseumAf2006,01.5was read in full indexed record. Purchase inMaputoSeptember2003is certain; manufactureinIndiaand2003productionarequestionedinthecatalogue. The card preserves that uncertainty and does not call the cloth an excavation. NationalMuseumsScotlandWITHCoastalStyle mainprojecttext was read indexed; directfetchfailed. It supports2019–2020research inKatembe, intergenerationalcloths andexhibitions. A related2022blog’sindexedtextwasreadbutitsdirectURLnowredirects; specificpersonalboatmemoriesfromthatblogare not used inthiscard. No unreadindividualinterview isinvented. Relatedprojectdescriptions count asonework.

UN1966A6300Add3PartIprintedp11was read in indexed text; directPDFopeningfailed. Thepassage recallsJune1964testimony aboutcoercivelabour, cropdemands andfamilyseparation. Thecard explicitlyattributes the account tospeakersandrecordedtestimony, omitsunverifiedtotals and loadedverbatimrhetoric, anddoesnotcall thecommitteeminutesanindependentlycheckedhouseholdcensus.

New copy isauthor-checkedpendingindependenthistorical-depthreview. Structuraltests do not certify exhaustivepoliticalhistory, borders orsource-neutrality. Publiccopy datesmodernrestorationandfieldwork ratherthanprojectingtheminto1650; undatedbroadercontext islabelledbytheinterface. No undocumentedfood, medicaltreatment ortoiletengineering is invented.

proposedOverrides.summary: Mozambique became independent from Portugal on 25 June 1975. Portuguese East Africa and the later Mozambique map records cover different parts of this regional history, including colonial years; their starting dates are not dates of national independence.

sharedAssociations.basis: Labels and mapped positions identify Portuguese colonial possessions and later Mozambique. A shared regional narrative distinguishes changing territory and colonial status from the1975independent state; it does not assert modern borders throughout.
